caption: This shio ramen features a clear, light broth with tender chashu pork and naruto fish cake nestled among noodles. Garnished with sliced green onions and a pink pickled radish, it sits in a red-trimmed bowl on a wooden table under soft, natural light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain patterns with smooth, slightly reflective finish.
The chashu pork is tender, thinly sliced, with a glistening surface and slight curl, revealing its juicy, cooked texture.
The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-yellow, and gently swirling around pale noodles with visible toppings.
The bowl is white ceramic with a red geometric patterned rim and smooth, glossy surface.
Naruto fish cake: pink swirl on white, scalloped edge, slightly translucent, with green garnish peeking from side.
